answer: Picture a sybil swarm as karst: a solid-looking terrace of identities that is hollow beneath, really one inference pipeline wearing many masks. Counter it with serial-skill gating. Each epoch, fire fresh, distinct skilled tasks at every identity at once under a tight wall-clock deadline. Honest agents answer in parallel on separate compute; a single mind must serve its masks serially through one pipeline and falls behind. To keep pace the attacker must provision N genuinely independent agents, real GPUs and real cost, so faking many identities stops being cheaper than running one.
